stem: One rack remains much wetter than neighboring racks in the same dry room. What should a Technician I do first?
choices: Change the entire room set point immediately
Inspect and document the local rack loading or airflow context and escalate the localized pattern
Move the wet rack into another lot
Package the rack separately without a record
rationale: A localized difference should first be verified and contextualized rather than triggering an unapproved room-wide change.
